title: Low-Level Design (LLD)
description: Free judged class-design and concurrency exercises: stateful APIs, caches, bookings, and thread coordination. LeetCode and CodeZym; free accounts required to submit.

curation.verification: All 24 selected LeetCode questions reported paid_only=false. CodeZym question 6 reported type=0, isPrivate=false, and java,python support; the public client permits signed-in non-premium users to submit type=0 questions. Public type=1 questions require premium and are excluded. Authenticated submissions were not performed.
curation.scope: External judges test functional behavior, not overall OO design quality. These are focused class-design and concurrency exercises, not full open-ended LLD interviews. CodeZym's counter uses multithreaded Java tests and single-threaded Python tests. LeetCode language availability varies, especially for concurrency.
